correctness.rationale: For tree graph-metrics, every nonparameter one-type corresponds bijectively to a three-state spin configuration forbidding only adjacent 1/3 labels; the published Katětov component formula and the independently derived subtree dynamic program count their distance-graded coefficients exactly. Recursive leaf attachment generates every unlabelled tree, and centre-rooted AHU strings are complete graph-isomorphism invariants, making the all-tree census through twelve exhaustive. The finite coefficient-group census gives no scalar collision before nine, no activity-polynomial collision before ten, and no full-grade collision before twelve; at each first order exactly one pair collides. All six witness trees were checked independently by brute \(3^n\) state enumeration; the earliest pair also passes full metric triangle-inequality enumeration. We make no inference about any order beyond twelve.

originality.rationale: The exact metric one-point type/Widom–Rowlinson correspondence is explicitly prior; the accepted object is the complete finite unlabelled-tree inverse census of three nested invariants and sharp first collisions at orders nine, ten and twelve, each uniquely paired. Direct full-text comparisons of the closest metric, homomorphism and extremal-tree publications did not identify these statements, nor do their claims imply the three collision thresholds. Extensive semantic and text queries found no equivalent census. Residual risk is an unindexed or differently named prior tree-homomorphism collision classification, so this is provisional same-model originality rather than certified priority.
residual_risks: Older unindexed fixed-target tree homomorphism tables or two-species Widom–Rowlinson polynomial collision results could cover some or all of the thresholds.
The 2025 extremal tree preprint covers exactly the target graph but not the same inverse conclusion; later work may address collisions.

Exhaustive computer-assisted classification relies on implemented canonical codes and dynamic programming, mitigated by the complete-generation proof, A000055 population totals and direct full-state witness checks.
